source: Each school's own MD-PhD (or DO-PhD) program page, read by hand; for a school with no combined program, the school's own degree or program page.
method: One page set per school (at most about six requests, 3 s or more apart plus jitter, the user agent MarlonJack/1.0 (contact: admin@rmhstudios.com)). A timeline is kept only when its evidence was re-fetched and found on the cited page after normalising whitespace, quotes and dashes (or, for tables, letters and digits in order); phase lengths are only those the page states, and a range stays a range in the phase label. Built by scripts/medschools/build-mdphd-data.ts.
ownerDecisions: Programs differ in layout (2-4-2, 3-4-1, 1.5-4-2.5 ...): show the school's own timeline where its page states it.
A program that does not state its layout is drawn as the typical 2-4-2, labelled "Typical layout; the program does not publish its own", never as the school's statement.
Not every school has a combined program: a school whose page shows none gets one quiet row; a school not decided here shows nothing.
MSTP (NIH T32) status comes from NIH RePORTER (data/medschools/mstp-t32.json); a program not found there is "not listed", never "no".
Every record cites its source: the program page for existence and the timeline, RePORTER for MSTP status.
verifier: pnpm exec tsx scripts/medschools/check-mdphd.ts re-fetches every timeline url politely and asserts the evidence is on it (run by hand; CI has no network).
